entities.name: VendingMachine
responsibilities: Accept coins and track the balance
Let the customer select a product by code
Dispense the product and return change

entities.name: MachineState
responsibilities: List machine states: IDLE, HAS_MONEY, DISPENSING, OUT_OF_SERVICE

entities.name: Inventory
responsibilities: Map slot codes to products and quantities

entities.name: Product
responsibilities: Hold the name and price in cents

entities.name: Coin
responsibilities: Supported coins with their value in cents

entities.name: ChangeCalculator
responsibilities: Work out which coins to return, largest first

entities.name: Display
responsibilities: Show the price, balance and messages to the customer

patterns.name: State
patterns.why: The machine behaves differently depending on whether money has been inserted.

keyFlows:
Buy: insertCoin() adds to the balance and moves IDLE -> HAS_MONEY. selectProduct(code) checks the Inventory; if the balance covers the price, dispense() releases the product, decrements stock, returns change from ChangeCalculator and goes back to IDLE.
Cancel: cancel() refunds the balance and returns to IDLE.
tradeOffs: Used an enum for states to keep it simple.
assumptions: Only coins are accepted. There are always enough coins to give change.
